data.comment: Diagnostic data from a concurrent session (child CG-0MTFO4H1P00210PE) blocked by this test: (1) TutorialOverlayClickThrough passes standalone (3/3 in 26s, even with the old 10s budget) and passes in 2-file and 6-file batches with composite-click/undo-redo/incident-reveal/peek/harness-cli. (2) It fails deterministically inside the FULL 94-file parallel browser stage: 4 consecutive full-suite runs failed at tests/main-street/TutorialOverlayClickThrough.browser.test.ts:88 (waitForStartButton) with BOTH the 10s and 40s budgets, at machine loads 2-24 — so it is NOT simple CPU-load dependence. (3) A fully-green full npm test DID pass at 13:50 IST today with the old 10s budget (same worktree basis) — before the 40s bump — suggesting accumulated Phaser 4 canvas/GPU context exhaustion in long parallel browser stages rather than this test's own code. Cf. AGENTS.md note: tutorial E2E parts each run in their OWN browser instance to avoid Phaser 4 canvas/GPU context exhaustion. Suggested leads: give this file its own browser instance/worker, reduce boots per case (3 full game boots with 154-card SVG regen per file), or investigate global GPU context state.
